visualCharacteristics: Light-blue (#d9edf7) callout box inline within tutorial text. Optional header line: icon (note / bulb) followed by bold label (NOTE / Quick Tip), then body text. The variant without option is body text only.
contentPattern: One row per callout (normally one), one cell: optional first paragraph with :note:/:bulb: icon + bold label, then body paragraph(s). A header-only row followed by a body row is merged into one callout.
usage: Inline notes and tips within tutorial steps. Use (note) for a NOTE callout with the :note: icon, (tip) for a Quick Tip with the :bulb: icon, or no option for a plain body-only callout.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any short highlighted aside in running text. Not for card grids (use cards) or code samples (use code-snippet).
